column1: # The pipeline manifest (prd.md S-17 阶段接口).  One row per stage, in order.
# Columns (TAB separated):  name  gen  exec  in  out  ref
# gen   builds the stage's delta at {delta}
# exec  runs the stage on {in} (a file of format `in`), output format `out` on
#       stdout; exit 0 accept, 1 reject k (stderr; `not covered...` counts as
#       not covered), anything else not covered / timeout.
# ref   the reference's stream of format `out`, from the C file {src}.
# An `in` format ending in `?` is a declared NOT-YET-CONNECTED edge: the
# upstream stage does not produce it.  run.py reports the gap and, with
# --ref-feed, feeds the stage the reference's stream (refin) instead.
# Columns 7 (delta path) and 8 (refin: reference producer of the `in` format).
# {x} is the per-checkout artefact dir (exec/stamp.sh); run.py builds {x}/ua_ref
# and {x}/ua_tdump and each delta through exec/stamp.sh fresh (stamped sources).
